title: Book 1 final test
intro: The whole book, still in three parts: match words, fill a gap, then finish a conversation. Pass with 70% or higher.

parts.title: Part 1 · Match the words
parts.intro: Words from all four sections. Choose the English meaning.

parts.title: Part 3 · Conversation
parts.intro: Pick the line that fits the scene.

questions.question: hvala
questions.explanation: Hvala means thank you. Molim is please, or you are welcome.

questions.question: želim
questions.explanation: Želim means I want. Imam means I have.

questions.question: lijevo
questions.explanation: Lijevo is left. Desno is right.

questions.question: torta
questions.explanation: Torta means cake. It shows up at the Lesson 30 party.

questions.question: Ja _____ Ana.
questions.explanation: Ja sam is I am. Si is you are. Je is he or she is.

questions.question: _____ je vrijeme?
questions.explanation: Kakvo je vrijeme? asks about the weather.

questions.question: Treba mi _____.
questions.explanation: Treba mi karta means I need a ticket.

questions.question: Volim grad _____ učim bosanski.
questions.explanation: I joins two present-tense facts: I love the city and I am learning Bosnian.

questions.question: Emir: Kako se zoveš? Ana: _____.
options: Zovem se Ana. Drago mi je.
questions.explanation: Name question, name answer. Drago mi je is nice to meet you.

questions.question: Amira: Izvoli. Ana: _____.
questions.explanation: When something is handed over, say hvala, then ask the price if you still need it.

questions.question: Waiter: Još nešto? Emir: _____.
questions.explanation: Još nešto? asks if you want anything else. Račun, molim asks for the bill.

questions.question: Amira: Živjeli! Svi: _____.
questions.explanation: A toast gets a toast. Vidimo se is see you, a warm close to Book 1.
